items.title: Document Centralization
items.description: Upload your invoices, delivery notes, and bank statements in one place. No more scattered documents.

items.title: Automatic OCR Extraction
items.description: Our system automatically reads your documents and extracts the date, amount, supplier, and type.

items.title: Automatic Accounting Entries
items.description: Based on the extracted data, ComptaNova generates accounting entries according to the Algerian PCG rules.

items.title: Validation by Accountant
items.description: The accountant checks, modifies, and validates each proposed entry before it is definitively recorded.

items.title: Bank Reconciliation
items.description: Import your CSV statement and let the algorithm automatically match your transactions with your entries.

items.title: Real-time Notifications
items.description: Stay informed at every step: new document received, entry validated, reconciliation completed.

how_section.title: How does it work?
how_section.subtitle: A simple and efficient workflow between the client and their accountant.

items.title: The client uploads documents
items.description: PDF invoices, check images, delivery notes — everything is centralized in the client area.

items.title: OCR extracts the data
items.description: The system automatically reads each document and proposes a corresponding accounting entry.

items.title: The accountant validates
items.description: The accountant verifies the proposed entries, modifies them if necessary, then validates them in one click.

items.title: Journal and reconciliation
items.description: Validated entries feed the journal. The bank statement is reconciled automatically.

hero.subtitle: ComptaNova was born from a simple vision: eliminate manual data entry and restore accountants to their true role as strategic advisors.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: Faced with slow traditional accounting processes and piles of paper invoices, we designed a platform capable of automating data processing using artificial intelligence (OCR).
story.p2: As an academic MVP project, ComptaNova aims to prove that it is possible to create a smooth, collaborative ecosystem between the accountant and their client, while strictly adhering to the Algerian General Accounting Plan (PCG).

goal.title: Our Goal
